productionEffectAfterMerge.committedInThisPr: no file under quant/data, discover/data or any other producer tree
productionEffectAfterMerge.secConsumerFundamentals: .github/workflows/sec-consumer-fundamentals.yml (cron Mon 07:30 UTC or dispatch) rewrites quant/data/sec/consumer/CIK*.json (all: versions; content as above), consumer/index.json, consumer-history/*.json.gz (shards of the changed issuers), consumer_coverage.json (new block secQuality), then discover/data (build-discover-data.mjs) and the capability matrix/projection
productionEffectAfterMerge.productIntelligence: .github/workflows/product-intelligence-materialization.yml (build-factor-evidence.mjs) then carries the new shares/marketCap/raw factor inputs into quant/data/product/factor-evidence-v1 for the issuers listed above
productionEffectAfterMerge.factbookPipeline: update-sec-fundamentals.yml (cron Mon 06:00 UTC) and sec-fundamentals-daily.yml re-normalize every stored factbook they touch, because the version stamp moved (pipeline._is_current); their canonical/inspector outputs change accordingly
